headline: Prudential Vietnam Post-Tax Profit Up 3.5 Times Year-on-Year in First Six Months of 2026
summary: Prudential Vietnam recorded first-half 2026 insurance revenue of over 8,219 billion dong, down 14%. Profit after tax exceeded 2,347 billion dong, 3.5 times the same period last year.
why: Prudential Vietnam is a life insurer whose results indicate the performance of the country's insurance sector, which investors follow for financial services exposure.
